headline: AI Red-Teaming and Vector Search Optimization Take Center Stage in Today's AI News
tldr: Today's AI news highlights the importance of AI red-teaming and the need for optimizing vector search. A recent breach using an autonomous AI agent underscores the urgency of red-teaming, while a new guide provides insights into optimizing vector search when RAM gets too expensive. These developments have significant implications for the security and efficiency of AI systems.

research.title: How to Optimize Vector Search When RAM Gets Too Expensive: On-Disk vs. In-Memory ANN Indexes
research.summary: This article discusses the trade-offs of using on-disk vs. in-memory ANN indexes for vector search, providing insights into optimizing vector search when RAM gets too expensive.
research.why_it_matters: This research matters because it helps developers and engineers architect cost-effective infrastructure for vector search, navigating the latency and storage trade-offs of different indexing techniques.

policy_society.title: A Complete Guide to AI Red-Teaming
policy_society.summary: This article provides a guide to AI red-teaming, highlighting the importance of testing AI systems for vulnerabilities and discussing a recent breach where an autonomous AI agent exploited an old SQL injection flaw.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This guide matters because it underscores the need for AI red-teaming, emphasizing the potential risks and consequences of not testing AI systems for vulnerabilities, and providing a resource for developers and organizations to improve their AI security.
